note: What may sit at the repository root: the first path segment of every tracked file. scripts/gates/root-entries.mjs counts the tracked files of every other root entry (a stray) and lets that number only fall against the merge-base, so a new name here is a decision made in the open: add it with a reason, in the PR that needs it. An entry that is no longer at the root must be deleted from this list.

allowed..cursor: Cursor rule and skill links that point AI tools at skills/ (kept in step with skills/ by tests/install.test.ts)
allowed..github: CI workflows and the pull request template
allowed..impeccable: design references and in-repo review screenshots; a gate keeps their number falling (scripts/gates/impeccable-files.mjs)
allowed..npmrc: pnpm registry and auth settings only
allowed.AGENTS.md: the working rules and reading order for agents and people (CLAUDE.md imports it)
allowed.CLAUDE.md: Claude Code entry that imports AGENTS.md
allowed.DESIGN.md: design norms the UI follows (AGENTS.md reading order)
allowed.Makefile: thin wrapper over the pnpm scripts
allowed.Start.sh: one-click start wizard, same as pnpm start
allowed.apps: applications: local host, workbench, CLI, MCP, desktop (docs/system/ARCHITECTURE.md)
allowed.examples: sample plugin package and seed examples
allowed.packages: foundation packages: contracts, kernel, storage, plugin SDK, test kit (docs/system/PACKAGE-BOUNDARIES.md)
allowed.pnpm-workspace.yaml: pnpm workspace definition and build allow-list
allowed.server: the embeddable server core: identity, devices, project access, handoff receipts, the IM chat (server/README.md; apps/server is its launcher)
allowed.skills: Skills shipped with the product and used by agents working on it
allowed.specs: specs in progress, current norms and BACKLOG.md (specs/README.md)
allowed.tooling: the plugin CLI and the gate baselines and allow-lists (tooling/gates)
allowed.tsconfig.json: TypeScript project for the product launchers
allowed.vendor: vendored packages (the Prologue SDK, at most two)
